title: The r3-hardened no-network lint fails on the shipped tree: demo_api.gleam still imports api/api_error, matching the new '^import api/' ban
evidence: test.yml (this commit's diff): `-          VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "api_helpers" client/src/demo/ ...)` -> `+          VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "api_helpers\|^import api/" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" || true)`; demo_api.gleam:18: `import api/api_error.{type ApiError}`. Running the exact lint grep on the tree prints `client/src/demo/demo_api.gleam:18:import api/api_error.{type ApiError}` (exit 0, VIOLATIONS non-empty -> the step exits 1).
detail: The commit hardened the CI grep to ban `import api/*` in demo/ (the r3 guard's 'import api/* banned in demo/') but left the api_error import behind (r2's api/auth_api import was removed; api_error was not). The lint step fails on the tree the moment CI runs; demo_api's header also falsely claims the lint passes.
recommended_fix: Drop the api/ import from demo_api.gleam (move ApiError off the api/ path, or construct the synthetic error without it) so the hardened grep runs clean.

title: demo_not_in_demo_toast still diverges from add_toast's id convention - toast ids collide (r2 #25 still present)
evidence: demo_update.gleam:617,624: `let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1` ... `next_toast_id: toast_id` // vs client.gleam:7089,7104: `let id = model.next_toast_id` ... `next_toast_id: id + 1`. After a demo toast (id N+1, next_toast_id N+1) the next add_toast reuses id N+1; the demo helper also skips add_toast's 5-toast cap (client.gleam:7095-7103).
detail: Two overlapping toasts can share one id; the first timeout's AppDismissToast dismisses both. r2 recommended routing demo toasts through the shared add_toast; not done.
recommended_fix: Route demo toasts through add_toast (or dispatch AppShowToast) instead of hand-rolling id assignment.

title: download_timeout and store_of still duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam - and the signatures have now drifted (r2 #21 still present)
evidence: client.gleam:6864: `fn download_timeout(analysis_id: String, delay_ms: Int) -> Effect(Msg)` (called with 90_000 at client.gleam:3163); demo_update.gleam:792: `fn download_timeout(id: String) -> Effect(Msg)` hardcoding `global.set_timeout(90_000, ...)`. client.gleam:5894 `fn demo_store_of(model: Model) -> DemoStore` vs demo_update.gleam:633 `fn store_of(model: Model) -> DemoStore` (both incl. the seed fallback).
detail: The drift r2 predicted has started: the real helper gained a delay_ms parameter while the demo copy hardcodes 90_000. Behavior matches today only because the sole real call site passes 90_000.
recommended_fix: Hoist both helpers into a shared module (e.g. demo/ imports client.gleam's, or move to helpers/) so there is one definition.

title: demo_store.notifications is a zero-caller pub export (r2 #19 residual still present)
evidence: `pub fn notifications(store: DemoStore) -> List(Notification) { store.notifications }` — grep across client/src + client/test finds only the definition site; all consumers use `notifications_unread` (demo_api.gleam: `deliver(on_response, demo_store.notifications_unread(store))`).
detail: Orphaned export shipped in new code; the compiler does not flag unused pub functions.

title: Demo reminders and bulk-invite still mutate nothing; hardcoded counts contradict the seeded awaiting list (r2 #24 still present)
evidence: `pub fn remind_applicant(store, _vacancy_id) -> #(store, #(1, 0))`; `pub fn send_reminder(store, _vacancy_id) -> #(store, #(2, 1))`; `pub fn send_bulk_invite(...) -> BulkInviteResult(sent: 2, invalid: 1, invalid_emails: ["bad@example.ie"], trimmed: 0)` — store returned unchanged, while `awaiting("v-maples")` seeds 3 rows whose `reminded` flags never change.
detail: Success toasts report counts unrelated to the seeded awaiting rows, and the awaiting surface never reflects a sent reminder.
recommended_fix: Derive the counts from the store and flip the reminded flag on the awaiting rows.

title: id_suffix truncation still guarantees id/short_code collisions for same-prefix property names (r2 #27 still present)
evidence: `fn id_suffix(value) ... case string.length(cleaned) { n if n <= 8 -> cleaned; n -> string.drop_end(cleaned, n - 8) }` and create_vacancy:1107 `let suffix = id_suffix(payload.property_name)` with `let id = "v-demo-" <> suffix` — no counter; its own doc (stranded at :1575) claims 'so re-created demo vacancies don't collide'.
detail: Creating two vacancies named e.g. 'My Apartment' produces identical v-demo-my-apart ids and RTDEMOmy-apart short_codes in a store keyed by id; the second silently shadows lookups for the first.
recommended_fix: Append a per-store counter (or existing-vacancy-count suffix) to the id suffix.

title: fetch_leaderboard_page still ignores its page parameter (r2 #28 still present; unreachable today)
evidence: `pub fn fetch_leaderboard_page(store, vacancy_id, _page, on_response)` -> `demo_store.leaderboard(store, vacancy_id)` (full list every page). The load-more button renders only `case loaded_count < total { True -> ... }` and the demo's first page returns all entries with total = list.length(entries), so the button never renders in demo.
detail: Latent: if the render condition changes or pagination is ever simulated, load-more would append and duplicate every row.
recommended_fix: Slice by page in the demo mirror, or replace-instead-of-append for the demo path.

title: Store-side change_status (mark_opened/set_status) still has no status guard - idempotency rests on the dispatch-layer set (r2 #29 still present)
evidence: change_status: `application: Application(..app.application, status: target), audit_trail: list.append(app.audit_trail, [AuditEntry(...)])` — unconditional overwrite + audit append for any matching id. The only guard is client.gleam:373 `application.Submitted -> !set.contains(open_dispatched, application_id)`.
detail: Latent: any future second dispatch path would double-append audit rows; the store's documented idempotency is not enforced where the mutation lives.
recommended_fix: Guard change_status on target != current status (no-op when already in the target state).

title: id_suffix's doc comment is stranded on add_days_iso; id_suffix itself is undocumented (r2 #18 residual still present)
evidence: :1575-1580 `/// Stable short id suffix from a property name (lowercase alphanumeric, up to 8 chars) so re-created demo vacancies don't collide.` immediately followed by `/// Add days to an ISO date-time string ...` then `fn add_days_iso(iso: String, days: Int) -> String`; `fn id_suffix` at :1647 has no doc comment.
detail: The two-line id_suffix doc was left glued above add_days_iso's doc when the rollover helpers were reworked; it now documents the wrong function (and promises non-collision id_suffix doesn't deliver).
recommended_fix: Move the id_suffix doc lines down to id_suffix (and fix the collision claim).
